description: The 100 most common Japanese Kanji characters
description_pt: Os 100 caracteres Kanji japoneses mais comuns

cards.question: 日
cards.explanation: Readings: にち (nichi), ひ (hi). Like a window with sunlight. Example: 日本 (nihon) = Japan.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: nichi, hi. Como uma janela com luz solar. Ex: 日本 (nihon) = Japão.

cards.question: 一
cards.explanation: Readings: いち (ichi), ひと (hito). One horizontal stroke = one. Example: 一人 (hitori) = one person.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ichi, hito. Um traço horizontal = um. Ex: 一人 (hitori) = uma pessoa.

cards.question: 国
cards.explanation: Readings: こく (koku), くに (kuni). Treasure (玉) inside borders. Example: 外国 (gaikoku) = foreign country.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: koku, kuni. Tesouro (玉) dentro de fronteiras. Ex: 外国 (gaikoku) = país estrangeiro.

cards.question: 人
cards.explanation: Readings: じん (jin), ひと (hito). A person walking. Example: 日本人 (nihonjin) = Japanese person.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: jin, hito. Uma pessoa caminhando. Ex: 日本人 (nihonjin) = pessoa japonesa.

cards.question: 年
cards.explanation: Readings: ねん (nen), とし (toshi). Grain harvest cycle. Example: 今年 (kotoshi) = this year.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: nen, toshi. Ciclo de colheita de grãos. Ex: 今年 (kotoshi) = este ano.

cards.question: 大
cards.explanation: Readings: だい (dai), おお (oo). Person with arms stretched wide. Example: 大学 (daigaku) = university.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: dai, oo. Pessoa com braços bem abertos. Ex: 大学 (daigaku) = universidade.

cards.question: 十
cards.explanation: Readings: じゅう (juu), とお (too). Cross representing 10. Example: 十分 (juubun) = enough/10 minutes.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: juu, too. Cruz representando 10. Ex: 十分 (juubun) = suficiente / 10 minutos.

cards.question: 二
cards.explanation: Readings: に (ni), ふた (futa). Two horizontal lines. Example: 二人 (futari) = two people.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ni, futa. Duas linhas horizontais. Ex: 二人 (futari) = duas pessoas.

cards.question: 本
cards.explanation: Readings: ほん (hon), もと (moto). Tree with root marked. Example: 日本 (nihon) = Japan, 本 (hon) = book.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hon, moto. Árvore com a raiz marcada. Ex: 日本 (nihon) = Japão, 本 (hon) = livro.

cards.question: 中
cards.explanation: Readings: ちゅう (chuu), なか (naka). Box with line through center. Example: 中国 (chuugoku) = China.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: chuu, naka. Caixa com linha pelo centro. Ex: 中国 (chuugoku) = China.

cards.question: 長
cards.explanation: Readings: ちょう (chou), なが (naga). Long flowing hair. Example: 社長 (shachou) = company president.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: chou, naga. Cabelo longo e esvoaçante. Ex: 社長 (shachou) = presidente da empresa.

cards.question: 出
cards.explanation: Readings: しゅつ (shutsu), で (de). Mountain peaks emerging. Example: 出口 (deguchi) = exit.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shutsu, de. Cumes de montanhas aparecendo. Ex: 出口 (deguchi) = saída.

cards.question: 三
cards.explanation: Readings: さん (san), み (mi). Three horizontal lines. Example: 三人 (sannin) = three people.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: san, mi. Três linhas horizontais. Ex: 三人 (sannin) = três pessoas.

cards.question: 時
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), とき (toki). Sun + temple = time told by temples. Example: 時間 (jikan) = time.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ji, toki. Sol + templo = tempo marcado pelos templos. Ex: 時間 (jikan) = tempo.

cards.question: 行
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou), い (i), ゆ (yu). Crossroads. Example: 行く (iku) = to go, 銀行 (ginkou) = bank.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kou, i. Encruzilhada. Ex: 行く (iku) = ir, 銀行 (ginkou) = banco.

cards.question: 見
cards.explanation: Readings: けん (ken), み (mi). Eye on legs. Example: 見る (miru) = to see, 意見 (iken) = opinion.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ken, mi. Olho sobre pernas. Ex: 見る (miru) = ver, 意見 (iken) = opinião.

cards.question: 月
cards.explanation: Readings: げつ (getsu), つき (tsuki). Crescent moon shape. Example: 今月 (kongetsu) = this month.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: getsu, tsuki. Forma de lua crescente. Ex: 今月 (kongetsu) = este mês.

cards.question: 分
cards.explanation: Readings: ぶん (bun), わ (wa), ふん (fun). Cutting with a knife. Example: 五分 (gofun) = 5 minutes.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: bun, wa, fun. Cortando com uma faca. Ex: 五分 (gofun) = 5 minutos.

cards.question: 後
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), あと (ato), のち (nochi). Walking behind. Example: 午後 (gogo) = afternoon.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: go, ato. Caminhando atrás. Ex: 午後 (gogo) = tarde.

cards.question: 前
cards.explanation: Readings: ぜん (zen), まえ (mae). Walking in front. Example: 午前 (gozen) = morning, 名前 (namae) = name.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: zen, mae. Caminhando na frente. Ex: 午前 (gozen) = manhã, 名前 (namae) = nome.

cards.question: 生
cards.explanation: Readings: せい (sei), い (i), う (u), は (ha). Plant sprouting from earth. Example: 学生 (gakusei) = student.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sei, i, u. Planta brotando da terra. Ex: 学生 (gakusei) = estudante.

cards.question: 五
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), いつ (itsu). Cross with top and bottom. Example: 五人 (gonin) = five people.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: go, itsu. Cruz com topo e base. Ex: 五人 (gonin) = cinco pessoas.

cards.question: 間
cards.explanation: Readings: かん (kan), あいだ (aida), ま (ma). Sun peeking through gate. Example: 時間 (jikan) = time.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kan, aida. Sol espiando pelo portão. Ex: 時間 (jikan) = tempo.

cards.question: 上
cards.explanation: Readings: じょう (jou), うえ (ue), あ (a), のぼ (nobo). Line above base. Example: 上手 (jouzu) = skillful.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: jou, ue. Linha acima da base. Ex: 上手 (jouzu) = habilidoso.

cards.question: 東
cards.explanation: Readings: とう (tou), ひがし (higashi). Sun rising behind tree. Example: 東京 (toukyou) = Tokyo.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: tou, higashi. Sol nascendo atrás da árvore. Ex: 東京 (toukyou) = Tóquio.

cards.question: 四
cards.explanation: Readings: し (shi), よん (yon), よ (yo). Mouth breathing four times. Example: 四人 (yonin) = four people.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shi, yon. Boca respirando quatro vezes. Ex: 四人 (yonin) = quatro pessoas.

cards.question: 今
cards.explanation: Readings: こん (kon), いま (ima). Roof over something. Example: 今日 (kyou) = today.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kon, ima. Telhado sobre algo. Ex: 今日 (kyou) = hoje.

cards.question: 金
cards.explanation: Readings: きん (kin), かね (kane). Golden nuggets underground. Example: お金 (okane) = money.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kin, kane. Pepitas de ouro sob a terra. Ex: お金 (okane) = dinheiro.

cards.question: 九
cards.explanation: Readings: きゅう (kyuu), く (ku), ここの (kokono). Almost complete circle. Example: 九月 (kugatsu) = September.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kyuu, ku. Círculo quase completo. Ex: 九月 (kugatsu) = Setembro.

cards.question: 入
cards.explanation: Readings: にゅう (nyuu), はい (hai), い (i). Arrow entering. Example: 入口 (iriguchi) = entrance.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: nyuu, hai, i. Flecha entrando. Ex: 入口 (iriguchi) = entrada.

cards.question: 学
cards.explanation: Readings: がく (gaku), まな (mana). Child under a roof learning. Example: 大学 (daigaku) = university.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: gaku, mana. Criança sob um telhado aprendendo. Ex: 大学 (daigaku) = universidade.

cards.question: 高
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou), たか (taka). Tall building with roof. Example: 高校 (koukou) = high school.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kou, taka. Edifício alto com telhado. Ex: 高校 (koukou) = escola de ensino médio.

cards.question: 円
cards.explanation: Readings: えん (en), まる (maru). Round coin. Example: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 yen.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: en, maru. Moeda redonda. Ex: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 ienes.

cards.question: 子
cards.explanation: Readings: し (shi), こ (ko). Baby with arms. Example: 子供 (kodomo) = child.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shi, ko. Bebê com braços. Ex: 子供 (kodomo) = criança.

cards.question: 外
cards.explanation: Readings: がい (gai), そと (soto), ほか (hoka). Evening moon = outside at night. Example: 外国 (gaikoku) = foreign country.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: gai, soto. Lua à noite = fora à noite. Ex: 外国 (gaikoku) = país estrangeiro.

cards.question: 八
cards.explanation: Readings: はち (hachi), や (ya), よう (you). Two lines spreading apart. Example: 八月 (hachigatsu) = August.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hachi, ya. Duas linhas se separando. Ex: 八月 (hachigatsu) = Agosto.

cards.question: 六
cards.explanation: Readings: ろく (roku), む (mu), むっ (mu). Roof with legs. Example: 六月 (rokugatsu) = June.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: roku, mu. Telhado com pernas. Ex: 六月 (rokugatsu) = Junho.

cards.question: 下
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), した (shita), さ (sa), お (o), くだ (kuda). Line below base. Example: 下手 (heta) = unskillful.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ka, shita. Linha abaixo da base. Ex: 下手 (heta) = não habilidoso.

cards.question: 來
cards.explanation: Readings: らい (rai), く (ku), き (ki). Rice plants coming in harvest. Example: 来年 (rainen) = next year.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: rai, ku. Plantas de arroz vindo na colheita. Ex: 来年 (rainen) = próximo ano.

cards.question: 気
cards.explanation: Readings: き (ki), け (ke). Steam rising. Example: 元気 (genki) = energetic, 天気 (tenki) = weather.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ki, ke. Vapor subindo. Ex: 元気 (genki) = energético, 天気 (tenki) = tempo.

cards.question: 小
cards.explanation: Readings: しょう (shou), ちい (chii), こ (ko), お (o). Small dividing strokes. Example: 小学校 (shougakkou) = elementary school.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shou, kii. Pequenos traços divisórios. Ex: 小学校 (shougakkou) = escola primária.

cards.question: 七
cards.explanation: Readings: しち (shichi), なな (nana). Bent line crossing. Example: 七月 (shichigatsu) = July.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shichi, nana. Linha dobrada cruzando. Ex: 七月 (shichigatsu) = Julho.

cards.question: 山
cards.explanation: Readings: さん (san), やま (yama). Mountain peaks! Example: 富士山 (fujisan) = Mt. Fuji.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: san, yama. Cumes de montanhas! Ex: 富士山 (fujisan) = Monte Fuji.

cards.question: 話
cards.explanation: Readings: わ (wa), はな (hana), はなし (hanashi). Words (言) from tongue. Example: 電話 (denwa) = telephone.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: wa, hana. Palavras (言) da língua. Ex: 電話 (denwa) = telefone.

cards.question: 女
cards.explanation: Readings: じょ (jo), おんな (onna), め (me). Woman kneeling elegantly. Example: 女性 (josei) = woman/female.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: jo, onna. Mulher ajoelhada elegantemente. Ex: 女性 (josei) = mulher/feminino.

cards.question: 北
cards.explanation: Readings: ほく (hoku), きた (kita). Two people back-to-back, fleeing cold. Example: 北海道 (hokkaidou) = Hokkaido.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hoku, kita. Duas pessoas de costas uma para a outra, fugindo do frio. Ex: 北海道 (hokkaidou) = Hokkaido.

cards.question: 午
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), うま (uma). Sun at its peak (12:00). Example: 午前 (gozen) = morning, 午後 (gogo) = afternoon.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: go, uma. Sol no seu auge (12:00). Ex: 午前 (gozen) = manhã, 午後 (gogo) = tarde.

cards.question: 百
cards.explanation: Readings: ひゃく (hyaku). One (一) + white (白). Example: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 yen.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hyaku. Um (一) + branco (白). Ex: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 ienes.

cards.question: 書
cards.explanation: Readings: しょ (sho), か (ka). Brush (聿) on paper (日). Example: 辞書 (jisho) = dictionary.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sho, ka. Pincel (聿) no papel (日). Ex: 辞書 (jisho) = dicionário.

cards.question: 先
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), さき (saki). Walking ahead. Example: 先生 (sensei) = teacher.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sen, saki. Caminhando à frente. Ex: 先生 (sensei) = professor.

cards.question: 名
cards.explanation: Readings: めい (mei), な (na). Evening moon (夕) + mouth (口) = calling a name at night. Example: 名前 (namae) = name.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: mei, na. Lua à noite (夕) + boca (口) = chamando um nome à noite. Ex: 名前 (namae) = nome.

cards.question: 川
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), かわ (kawa). Three lines of flowing water. Example: 山川 (yamakawa) = mountains and rivers.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sen, kawa. Três linhas de água fluindo. Ex: 山川 (yamakawa) = montanhas e rios.

cards.question: 千
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), ち (chi). One (一) + person (人) = many people. Example: 三千 (sanzen) = 3,000.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sen, chi. Um (一) + pessoa (人) = muitas pessoas. Ex: 三千 (sanzen) = 3.000 ienes.

cards.question: 水
cards.explanation: Readings: すい (sui), みず (mizu). Splashing water. Example: 水曜日 (suiyoubi) = Wednesday.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sui, mizu. Água espirrando. Ex: 水曜日 (suiyoubi) = quarta-feira.

cards.question: 半
cards.explanation: Readings: はん (han), なか (naka). Dividing into two parts. Example: 半年 (hantoshi) = half year.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: han, naka. Dividindo em duas partes. Ex: 半年 (hantoshi) = meio ano.

cards.question: 男
cards.explanation: Readings: だん (dan), おとこ (otoko). Rice field (田) + strength (力) = working the fields. Example: 男性 (dansei) = man/male.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: dan, otoko. Campo de arroz (田) + força (力) = trabalhando nos campos. Ex: 男性 (dansei) = homem/masculino.

cards.question: 西
cards.explanation: Readings: せい (sei), にし (nishi). Bird in nest as sun sets. Example: 西口 (nishiguchi) = west exit.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sei, nishi. Pássaro no ninho enquanto o sol se põe. Ex: 西口 (nishiguchi) = saída oeste, 関西 (kansai).

cards.question: 電
cards.explanation: Readings: でん (den). Rain (雨) + lightning (申). Example: 電車 (densha) = train.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: den. Chuva (雨) + raio (申). Ex: 電話 (denwa) = telefone, 電車 (densha) = trem.

cards.question: 校
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou). Tree (木) + exchange (交) = place of exchange under trees. Example: 学校 (gakkou) = school.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kou. Árvore (木) + troca (交) = lugar de troca sob as árvores. Ex: 学校 (gakkou) = escola.

cards.question: 語
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go). Words (言) + I (五 + 口). Example: 日本語 (nihongo) = Japanese language.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: go. Palavras (言) + eu (五 + 口). Ex: 日本語 (nihongo) = língua japonesa.

cards.question: 土
cards.explanation: Readings: ど (do), つち (tsuchi). Sprout coming from soil. Example: 土曜日 (doyoubi) = Saturday.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: do, tsuchi. Broto saindo da terra. Ex: 土曜日 (doyoubi) = sábado.

cards.question: 木
cards.explanation: Readings: もく (moku), き (ki). Shape of a tree with branches. Example: 木曜日 (mokuyoubi) = Thursday.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: moku, ki. Forma de uma árvore com galhos. Ex: 木曜日 (mokuyoubi) = quinta-feira.

cards.question: 聞
cards.explanation: Readings: ぶん (bun), き (ki). Ear (耳) at the gate (門). Example: 聞く (kiku) = to hear, 新聞 (shinbun) = newspaper.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: bun, ki. Ouvido (耳) no portão (門). Ex: 聞く (kiku) = ouvir, 新聞 (shinbun) = jornal.

cards.question: 食
cards.explanation: Readings: しょく (shoku), た (ta). Person with food under a roof. Example: 食べる (taberu) = to eat, 食事 (shokuji) = meal.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shoku, ta. Pessoa com comida sob um telhado. Ex: 食べる (taberu) = comer, 食事 (shokuji) = refeição.

cards.question: 車
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), くるま (kuruma). Overhead view of a carriage. Example: 電車 (densha) = train.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sha, kuruma. Vista superior de uma carruagem. Ex: 電車 (densha) = trem, 自動車 (jidousha) = carro.

cards.question: 何
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), なに (nani), なん (nan). Person carrying something. Example: 何 (nani) = what, 何時 (nanji) = what time.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ka, nani, nan. Pessoa carregando algo. Ex: 何 (nani) = o quê, 何時 (nanji) = que horas.

cards.question: 南
cards.explanation: Readings: なん (nan), みなみ (minami). Lush vegetation in warm south. Example: 南口 (minamiguchi) = south exit.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: nan, minami. Vegetação exuberante no sul quente. Ex: 南口 (minamiguchi) = saída sul.

cards.question: 万
cards.explanation: Readings: まん (man). Ancient symbol for many. Example: 一万 (ichiman) = 10,000.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: man. Símbolo antigo para muitos. Ex: 一万 (ichiman) = 10.000 ienes.

cards.question: 毎
cards.explanation: Readings: まい (mai). Mother (母) + one stroke. Example: 毎日 (mainichi) = every day.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: mai. Mãe (母) + um traço. Ex: 毎日 (mainichi) = cada dia / todos os dias.

cards.question: 白
cards.explanation: Readings: はく (haku), しろ (shiro). Sunlight (日) with a ray. Example: 白い (shiroi) = white.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: haku, shiro. Luz solar (日) com um raio. Ex: 白い (shiroi) = branco.

cards.question: 天
cards.explanation: Readings: てん (ten). Big (大) + one stroke above. Example: 天気 (tenki) = weather.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ten. Grande (大) + um traço acima. Ex: 天気 (tenki) = tempo / clima.

cards.question: 母
cards.explanation: Readings: ぼ (bo), はは (haha). Woman (女) with dots for breasts. Example: お母さん (okaasan) = mother.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: bo, haha. Mulher (女) com pontos para os seios. Ex: お母さん (okaasan) = mãe.

cards.question: 火
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), ひ (hi). Flickering flames. Example: 火曜日 (kayoubi) = Tuesday.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ka, hi. Chamas oscilantes. Ex: 火曜日 (kayoubi) = terça-feira.

cards.question: 右
cards.explanation: Readings: う (u), ゆう (yuu), みぎ (migi). Hand (又) + mouth (口) = side that feeds. Example: 右手 (migite) = right hand.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: u, yuu, migi. Mão (又) + boca (口) = lado que alimenta. Ex: 右手 (migite) = mão direita.

cards.question: 読
cards.explanation: Readings: どく (doku), よ (yo). Words (言) + seller (売) = reciting. Example: 読む (yomu) = to read.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: doku, yo. Palavras (言) + vendedor (売) = recitar. Ex: 読む (yomu) = ler.

cards.question: 友
cards.explanation: Readings: ゆう (yuu), とも (tomo). Two hands (又) helping each other. Example: 友達 (tomodachi) = friend.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: yuu, tomo. Duas mãos (又) se ajudando. Ex: 友達 (tomodachi) = amigo.

cards.question: 左
cards.explanation: Readings: さ (sa), ひだり (hidari). Hand + work = left hand works. Example: 左 (hidari) = left.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sa, hidari. Mão + trabalho = mão esquerda trabalha. Ex: 左 (hidari) = esquerda.

cards.question: 休
cards.explanation: Readings: きゅう (kyuu), やす (yasu). Person against tree = resting. Example: 休む (yasumu) = to rest.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kyuu, yasu. Pessoa contra árvore = descansando. Ex: 休む (yasumu) = descansar.

cards.question: 父
cards.explanation: Readings: ふ (fu), ちち (chichi). Person with authority. Example: お父さん (otousan) = father.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: fu, chichi. Pessoa com autoridade. Ex: お父さん (otousan) = pai.

cards.question: 雨
cards.explanation: Readings: う (u), あめ (ame), あま (ama). Clouds with raindrops. Example: 雨 (ame) = rain.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: u, ame. Nuvens com gotas de chuva. Ex: 雨 (ame) = chuva.

cards.question: 道
cards.explanation: Readings: どう (dou), みち (michi). Walking + head = knowing the way. Example: 道 (michi) = road, 柔道 (juudou) = judo.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: dou, michi. Caminhando + cabeça = sabendo o caminho. Ex: 道 (michi) = estrada, 柔道 (judo).

cards.question: 駅
cards.explanation: Readings: えき (eki). Horse + stacked = horses at rest stop. Example: 駅 (eki) = train station.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: eki. Cavalo + empilhado = cavalos na parada. Ex: 駅 (eki) = estação de trem.

cards.question: 会
cards.explanation: Readings: かい (kai), あ (a). Roof + speak = meeting together. Example: 会う (au) = to meet, 会社 (kaisha) = company.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kai, a. Telhado + fala = encontrando-se. Ex: 会う (au) = encontrar-se, 会社 (kaisha) = empresa.

cards.question: 同
cards.explanation: Readings: どう (dou), おな (ona). Same container for all. Example: 同じ (onaji) = same.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: dou, ona. Mesmo recipiente para todos. Ex: 同じ (onaji) = igual.

cards.question: 事
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), ず (zu), こと (koto). Hand doing something. Example: 仕事 (shigoto) = work.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ji, koto. Mão fazendo algo. Ex: 仕事 (shigoto) = trabalho.

cards.question: 自
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), し (shi), みずか (mizuka). Point at nose = self. Example: 自分 (jibun) = oneself.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ji, shi. Apontar para o nariz = eu mesmo. Ex: 自分 (jibun) = si mesmo.

cards.question: 社
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), やしろ (yashiro). Altar + earth = shrine, company. Example: 会社 (kaisha) = company.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sha, yashiro. Altar + terra = santuário, empresa. Ex: 会社 (kaisha) = empresa.

cards.question: 発
cards.explanation: Readings: はつ (hatsu), ほつ (hotsu). Feet starting to leave. Example: 出発 (shuppatsu) = departure.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hatsu, hotsu. Pés começando a partir. Ex: 出発 (shuppatsu) = partida.

cards.question: 者
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), もの (mono). Old man = wise person. Example: 記者 (kisha) = journalist.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: sha, mono. Homem velho = pessoa sábia. Ex: 記者 (kisha) = jornalista.

cards.question: 地
cards.explanation: Readings: ち (chi), じ (ji). Earth + foundation. Example: 地下 (chika) = underground.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: chi, ji. Terra + base. Ex: 地下 (chika) = subterrâneo.

cards.question: 業
cards.explanation: Readings: ぎょう (gyou), ごう (gou), わざ (waza). Complex work activities. Example: 授業 (jugyou) = class.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: gyou, gou. Atividades complexas de trabalho. Ex: 授業 (jugyou) = aula.

cards.question: 方
cards.explanation: Readings: ほう (hou), かた (kata). Forked path direction. Example: 方向 (houkou) = direction.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: hou, kata. Direção de um caminho bifurcado. Ex: 方向 (houkou) = direção.

cards.question: 新
cards.explanation: Readings: しん (shin), あたら (atara), あら (ara), にい (nii). Tree cut for new wood. Example: 新聞 (shinbun) = newspaper.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shin, atara. Árvore cortada para madeira nova. Ex: 新聞 (shinbun) = jornal.

cards.question: 場
cards.explanation: Readings: じょう (jou), ば (ba). Earth + ease = comfortable place. Example: 場所 (basho) = place.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: jou, ba. Terra + facilidade = lugar confortável. Ex: 場所 (basho) = lugar.

cards.question: 員
cards.explanation: Readings: いん (in). Mouth + cowrie shell = counted member. Example: 会員 (kaiin) = member.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: in. Boca + búzio = membro contado. Ex: 会員 (kaiin) = membro.

cards.question: 立
cards.explanation: Readings: りつ (ritsu), た (ta). Person standing on ground. Example: 立つ (tatsu) = to stand.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ritsu, ta. Pessoa em pé no chão. Ex: 立つ (tatsu) = ficar em pé.

cards.question: 開
cards.explanation: Readings: かい (kai), ひら (hira), あ (a). Door with hands opening both sides. Example: 開く (hiraku) = to open.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: kai, hira. Porta com as mãos abrindo ambos os lados. Ex: 開く (hiraku) = abrir.

cards.question: 手
cards.explanation: Readings: しゅ (shu), て (te), た (ta). Fingers and palm. Example: 上手 (jouzu) = skillful, 手紙 (tegami) = letter.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: shu, te. Dedos e palma. Ex: 上手 (jouzu) = habilidoso, 手紙 (tegami) = carta.

cards.question: 力
cards.explanation: Readings: りょく (ryoku), りき (riki), ちから (chikara). Flexed arm muscle. Example: 力 (chikara) = power.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: ryoku, riki. Músculo do braço flexionado. Ex: 力 (chikara) = poder.

cards.question: 目
cards.explanation: Readings: もく (moku), め (me). Eye shape sideways. Example: 目 (me) = eye, 目標 (mokuhyou) = goal.
cards.explanation_pt: Leituras: moku, me. Formato de olho de lado. Ex: 目 (me) = olho, 目標 (mokuhyou) = objetivo.
